tei:titleStmt.tei:title: Birkat HaLevana: Blessed are You, Adonoy, our God, King of the Universe, Who

tei:availability.tei:p: Published by Sefaria under CC-BY, which Sefaria defines as Creative Commons Attribution 3.0.

tei:div.tei:p: Blessed are You, Adonoy, our God, King of the Universe, Who with His utterance created the heavens, and with the breath of His mouth, all their host. Law and season did He give them, that they not deviate from their set function. They are glad and rejoice to do the will of their Possessor —the Worker of truth Whose work is true. The moon He directed to renew itself— a crown of glory to those who are borne by him from the womb, who are also destined to be renewed, and to glorify their Creator for the Name of His glorious kingdom. Blessed are You, Adonoy, Renewer of the months.

tei:note.tei:p: See Isaiah 46:3, “Israel which is borne by me from the belly, which is carried by Me from the womb.”
